responsibility: Implements tree-level tail-call analysis and optimization, including classic tail recursion elimination and limited accumulator-based conversion of simple linear recurrences. It finds return-site calls, checks function suitability and ABI/EH constraints, records additive and multiplicative adjustment forms around self-calls, rewrites recursive tail calls into argument assignments plus loop backedges, updates return statements when accumulators are introduced, and exposes tail-call information for later sibling-call optimization.
